Fifty ran too long for the interpreter's step limit and were set aside. <bookmark mark='d'/> The other hundred and ninety, compiled at all four levels and run on the emulator, gave no mismatches. <bookmark mark='e'/> That was not true while the compiler was being built. The fuzzer found that a parameter assigned in the entry block was never renamed into SSA, which broke nine programs. And it found a bug in the reference itself: the interpreter assumed that dividing by zero gives minus one, as RISC-V does, but Pebble traps. A tester is only as good as its notion of the right answer.
610519b42e35.zh: 我们对自己的编译器做了同样的事。<bookmark mark='a'/>一个生成器写出随机的 Pebble 程序，带有嵌套循环、数组、指针和全局变量。每个循环都有界，每个下标都被约束到范围之内，每个除数都是一个平方数加一，所以永远不为零。<bookmark mark='b'/>参考答案来自 IR 解释器，它完全不经优化器就运行程序。<bookmark mark='c'/>我们生成了两百四十个程序，每个大约八十行。有五十个运行时间超出了解释器的步数上限，被放在一边。<bookmark mark='d'/>其余一百九十个，在全部四个级别上编译，在模拟器上运行，没有一个不一致。<bookmark mark='e'/>在编译器还在搭建的时候，情况并非如此。模糊测试发现：在入口块里被赋值的参数从未被改名进 SSA，这弄坏了九个程序。它还发现了参考答案本身的错误：解释器以为除以零得到负一，就像 RISC-V 那样，可是 Pebble 会陷入异常。测试者的好坏，取决于它对正确答案的理解。

268cde5bae51.en: Testing samples a few inputs. For the small algebraic rules of chapter seven we can do better, and check every input at once. <bookmark mark='a'/> Ask an SMT solver, here z3: is there any thirty-two-bit x for which the two sides differ? If the answer is no, the rule is proved. If yes, the solver hands back an x. <bookmark mark='b'/> Multiplying by eight is shifting by three: proved. Dividing by two is shifting right by one: false, at x equals minus one. The correct version adds the sign bit before shifting: proved. x plus one is greater than x: false at the largest integer, where it overflows. And x times three, divided by three, is x: false, at a number the solver found by itself. <bookmark mark='c'/> In 2015 the Alive project translated three hundred and thirty-four of LLVM's peephole rules into this form, and found eight that were wrong.
268cde5bae51.zh: 测试只是抽查几个输入。对第七章那些小的代数规则，我们可以做得更好，一次检查所有输入。<bookmark mark='a'/>问一个 SMT 求解器，这里用 z3：是否存在某个三十二位的 x，使两边不相等？如果答案是没有，规则就得到了证明。如果有，求解器会交回一个 x。<bookmark mark='b'/>乘以八等于左移三位：已证明。除以二等于右移一位：错，在 x 等于负一时。正确的版本在移位之前先加上符号位：已证明。x 加一大于 x：错，在最大的整数处，那里会溢出。x 乘三再除以三等于 x：错，在求解器自己找到的一个数上。<bookmark mark='c'/>2015 年，Alive 项目把 LLVM 的三百三十四条窥孔规则翻译成这种形式，发现其中八条是错的。

ca2babd45c96.en: These are rungs on a ladder. <bookmark mark='a'/> Differential testing finds bugs, but can never show there are none. <bookmark mark='b'/> Rule checking proves each small rewrite correct. <bookmark mark='c'/> Translation validation proves each compilation correct after the fact: a separate checker confirms that this output means the same as this input, and if it cannot, the build fails. <bookmark mark='d'/> And a verified compiler is proved correct once, for every program. Xavier Leroy's CompCert, a C compiler written and proved in the Coq proof assistant, is the landmark; Airbus uses it for flight software. <bookmark mark='e'/> How such proofs work is Part 54. And Part 55, the finale, asks the strangest question of all: Ken Thompson's compiler that lies about itself, and whether you can trust any compiler you did not write.
ca2babd45c96.zh: 这些是一架梯子上的几级横档。<bookmark mark='a'/>差分测试能发现错误，但永远无法证明没有错误。<bookmark mark='b'/>规则检查证明每一条小的改写是正确的。<bookmark mark='c'/>翻译确认在事后证明每一次编译是正确的：一个独立的检查器确认这份输出和这份输入含义相同，如果确认不了，构建就失败。<bookmark mark='d'/>而经过验证的编译器只需证明一次，对所有程序都正确。泽维尔·勒鲁瓦的 CompCert，一个用 Coq 证明助手写成并证明的 C 编译器，是这方面的里程碑；空客用它来编译飞行软件。<bookmark mark='e'/>这样的证明怎样进行，是第54部分的内容。而第55部分，也就是终章，会问一个最奇怪的问题：肯·汤普森那个对自己撒谎的编译器，以及你能否信任任何一个不是你自己写的编译器。

a6f7247c1370.en: Chapter fifteen. Frontier: searching for the best program.
a6f7247c1370.zh: 第十五章。前沿：搜索最好的程序。

5a0c1a1cfd03.en: Despite the name, an optimizing compiler does not optimize. <bookmark mark='a'/> It applies rules that usually help, and nothing guarantees that the result is the best program possible. <bookmark mark='b'/> In fact no compiler can always find the best. Consider this program: one instruction that jumps to itself. It is the smallest program that runs forever and prints nothing. <bookmark mark='c'/> A compiler that always produced the smallest equivalent program would output exactly this whenever its input never halts, and so it would decide the halting problem. <bookmark mark='d'/> Andrew Appel calls this the full employment theorem for compiler writers: there will always be a better optimizer to build. But for short pieces of code, we can search.
5a0c1a1cfd03.zh: 尽管名字如此，优化编译器并不真正求最优。<bookmark mark='a'/>它应用的是通常有帮助的规则，没有任何东西保证结果是可能的最好程序。<bookmark mark='b'/>事实上，没有哪个编译器总能找到最好的。看这个程序：一条跳到自己的指令。它是永远运行、什么也不打印的最小程序。<bookmark mark='c'/>一个总能产生最小等价程序的编译器，在输入永不停机时就会恰好输出它，于是它就判定了停机问题。<bookmark mark='d'/>安德鲁·阿佩尔把这叫作编译器作者的充分就业定理：总会有更好的优化器等着人去造。不过对短小的代码片段，我们可以去搜索。

8702cac5ace9.en: In 1987 Henry Massalin built the first superoptimizer. <bookmark mark='a'/> Enumerate every instruction sequence of length one, then two, then three. Run each on a few dozen test inputs, and throw away any that disagrees with the target function. <bookmark mark='b'/> Then prove the survivors correct for every input. Massalin checked his mostly by hand; we can ask z3. <bookmark mark='c'/> Ours finds the shortest Pebble programs for these small functions. Is x nonzero: one instruction. Is x equal to y: two. Clear the lowest set bit: two. <bookmark mark='d'/> Absolute value without a branch: three. Shift right by thirty-one, which gives zero or minus one; add it; exclusive-or with it. For a negative x, that subtracts one and flips every bit, which is negation. Signed division by two, correct for negative numbers: three. And the minimum of two numbers, with no branch: four, using a multiply.
8702cac5ace9.zh: 1987 年，亨利·马萨林造出了第一个超级优化器。<bookmark mark='a'/>枚举长度为一的每一个指令序列，然后是二，然后是三。在几十个测试输入上运行每一个，丢掉任何与目标函数不一致的。<bookmark mark='b'/>再证明幸存者对每个输入都正确。马萨林大多是手工检查的；我们可以问 z3。<bookmark mark='c'/>我们的超级优化器为这些小函数找到了最短的 Pebble 程序。x 是否非零：一条指令。x 是否等于 y：两条。清掉最低的一位 1：两条。<bookmark mark='d'/>不用分支的绝对值：三条。右移三十一位，得到零或负一；加上它；再与它做异或。对负的 x，这相当于减一再把每一位取反，也就是取负。对负数也正确的有符号除以二：三条。不用分支的两数最小值：四条，用到一次乘法。

a135bf36da9d.en: The catch is the cost. <bookmark mark='a'/> The longest search at each length: a few milliseconds for one instruction, under a second for three, and four minutes for the four-instruction minimum, on a logarithmic scale. <bookmark mark='b'/> Each new instruction can be any of twenty operations, on any pair of the registers computed so far, so each extra instruction multiplies the search by hundreds. Pruning helps: a sequence whose new value was already computed some shorter way is skipped. But brute force runs out at about five instructions, far short of a whole function.
a135bf36da9d.zh: 问题在于代价。<bookmark mark='a'/>每个长度下最长的那次搜索：一条指令几毫秒，三条指令不到一秒，四条指令的最小值要四分钟，这是对数刻度。<bookmark mark='b'/>每条新指令可以是大约二十种运算中的任意一种，作用在到目前为止算出的任意一对寄存器上，所以每多一条指令，搜索量就乘以几百。剪枝有帮助：如果一个序列的新值已经用更短的方式算过，就跳过它。可是蛮力搜索大约到五条指令就到头了，离一个完整的函数还差得远。

0104fcda9373.en: Smarter search goes further. <bookmark mark='a'/> STOKE, from Stanford in 2013, takes a random walk through the space of x86 programs. Each step changes one instruction, and a step is kept with a probability that depends on a cost: how wrong the program is on the tests, plus how slow it is estimated to be. Walking downhill, mostly, it found loop bodies faster than gcc at its highest level, and as fast as expert hand-written assembly. <bookmark mark='b'/> Souper, from 2017, uses an SMT solver to synthesize smaller replacements for pieces of LLVM IR, and reports what it finds as optimizations the compiler is missing. Many have since been added to LLVM by hand. <bookmark mark='c'/> And AlphaDev, from DeepMind in 2023, used reinforcement learning to search assembly programs that sort three, four and five numbers. Its routines were shorter than the human ones, and they are now in LLVM's C++ library.
0104fcda9373.zh: 更聪明的搜索能走得更远。<bookmark mark='a'/>斯坦福 2013 年的 STOKE 在 x86 程序的空间里随机游走。每一步改一条指令，按一个依赖于代价的概率决定是否保留这一步：代价是程序在测试上错得有多厉害，加上估计它有多慢。大体上一路下坡，它找到了比 gcc 最高级别更快、和专家手写汇编一样快的循环体。<bookmark mark='b'/>2017 年的 Souper 用 SMT 求解器为 LLVM IR 的片段合成更小的替代品，并把找到的东西报告为编译器漏掉的优化。其中许多后来被人手工加进了 LLVM。<bookmark mark='c'/>还有 DeepMind 2023 年的 AlphaDev，用强化学习在汇编程序中搜索给三个、四个、五个数排序的例程。它的例程比人写的更短，如今已经进入 LLVM 的 C++ 库。

5689def000c0.en: A newer idea attacks the phase-ordering problem of chapter seven head on. <bookmark mark='a'/> Take a times two, times two, and four rewrite rules, all true for thirty-two-bit integers. <bookmark mark='b'/> Apply one rule at a time and the order matters. Turn the inner multiply into a shift first, and you end with two shifts; the rule that would have combined the multiplies no longer applies. <bookmark mark='c'/> Equality saturation never chooses. It keeps an e-graph, in which each class holds expressions already known to be equal. a times two and a shifted by one share a class. So do two times two, and four. <bookmark mark='d'/> The whole expression's class collects every version the rules can reach: c one times two, c one shifted by one, a times c four, and a shifted by two. Rules are applied everywhere, again and again, until nothing new appears. <bookmark mark='e'/> Then the cheapest version is extracted: a single shift by two. Tate and others introduced the idea in 2009, and the egg library of 2021 made it fast; it is now used in compilers for hardware, for floating-point accuracy, and in Cranelift, a production code generator.
5689def000c0.zh: 一个更新的想法正面攻击第七章的阶段顺序问题。<bookmark mark='a'/>拿 a 乘二再乘二，以及四条改写规则，它们对三十二位整数都成立。<bookmark mark='b'/>一次应用一条规则，顺序就很重要。先把里面的乘法变成移位，最后会得到两次移位；本来能把两次乘法合并起来的那条规则就用不上了。<bookmark mark='c'/>等式饱和从不做选择。它维护一个 e 图，其中每个类都装着已知相等的表达式。a 乘二和 a 左移一位在同一个类里。二乘二和四也在同一个类里。<bookmark mark='d'/>整个表达式的类收集规则能到达的每一个版本：c1 乘二、c1 左移一位、a 乘 c4，以及 a 左移两位。规则在各处一遍又一遍地应用，直到不再出现新东西。<bookmark mark='e'/>然后取出最便宜的版本：一次左移两位。泰特等人在 2009 年提出了这个想法，2021 年的 egg 库让它变快；如今它被用在硬件编译器里、浮点精度改进里，还有生产级代码生成器 Cranelift 里。

e4f429127f6f.en: The other direction is to learn. <bookmark mark='a'/> A compiler is full of guesses. Inline this call? Spill which value? Unroll this loop how far? Each is a hand-tuned heuristic. <bookmark mark='b'/> In 2021 Google's MLGO project replaced LLVM's inlining heuristic with a small neural network, trained by reinforcement learning to make code smaller, and later did the same for which value the register allocator evicts. <bookmark mark='c'/> It saves a few percent of code size in production. <bookmark mark='d'/> The difficulties are practical: the guess must be fast, since it runs millions of times, and it must stay good as the programs being compiled change. <bookmark mark='e'/> How such policies are trained is the subject of our companion series, AI, Built.
e4f429127f6f.zh: 另一个方向是学习。<bookmark mark='a'/>编译器里充满了猜测。内联这次调用吗？溢出哪个值？这个循环展开多少？每一个都是手工调好的启发式。<bookmark mark='b'/>2021 年，谷歌的 MLGO 项目用一个小神经网络替换了 LLVM 的内联启发式，用强化学习训练它让代码变小，后来又对寄存器分配器驱逐哪个值做了同样的事。<bookmark mark='c'/>它在生产中节省了百分之几的代码体积。<bookmark mark='d'/>困难都很实际：猜测必须快，因为它要运行几百万次；还必须在被编译的程序变化时依然好用。<bookmark mark='e'/>这样的策略怎样训练，是我们的姊妹系列《AI，从零搭建》的主题。

feccfe716031.en: Here is where the field stands. <bookmark mark='a'/> SSA programs colour optimally in linear time, but deciding what to spill, and which copies to coalesce, remains NP-hard even on SSA. How well can these be approximated? <bookmark mark='b'/> Extracting the cheapest program from an e-graph is NP-hard once parts can be shared; which cost models are tractable? <bookmark mark='c'/> CompCert is proved correct, but its code runs at about the speed of gcc at level one. Can a verified compiler match level three? <bookmark mark='d'/> And can we superoptimize whole loops rather than five instructions, by search, by proof, or by learning? <bookmark mark='e'/> The research problem of this part takes up the first of these.
feccfe716031.zh: 这个领域现在的状况是这样的。<bookmark mark='a'/>SSA 程序能在线性时间内最优着色，但决定溢出什么、合并哪些复制，即使在 SSA 上仍然是 NP 难的。这些能近似到什么程度？<bookmark mark='b'/>一旦各部分可以共享，从 e 图中取出最便宜的程序就是 NP 难的；哪些代价模型是可处理的？<bookmark mark='c'/>CompCert 被证明是正确的，但它生成的代码大约只有 gcc 第一级的速度。经过验证的编译器能达到第三级吗？<bookmark mark='d'/>我们能否超级优化整个循环，而不只是五条指令，靠搜索、靠证明，还是靠学习？<bookmark mark='e'/>这一部分的研究问题，处理的是其中的第一个。

bc4b73db99d9.en: What we built in this part. FORTRAN's promise, and the three-part shape of every compiler since. A checker for names, scopes, types and layouts. Three-address code, basic blocks and control-flow graphs; dominators, and the dominance frontiers where SSA places its phis. Dataflow analysis, as a least fixed point on a lattice. Constant propagation, value numbering, dead code elimination, loop inversion, invariant code motion, strength reduction and inlining, each measured on the Job. Instruction selection by tiling, register allocation by colouring, and the chordal graphs that make it easy in SSA. Scheduling, and the predictor a compiler takes for granted. A fuzzer and a solver to check it all, and a superoptimizer to search for what the rules miss.
bc4b73db99d9.zh: 这一部分我们搭建了什么。FORTRAN 的承诺，以及此后每个编译器的三段式形状。一个检查名字、作用域、类型和布局的检查器。三地址码、基本块和控制流图；支配者，以及 SSA 放置 φ 的支配边界。数据流分析，作为格上的最小不动点。常量传播、值编号、死代码消除、循环反转、不变代码外提、强度削弱和内联，每一个都在任务上测量。用铺砖做指令选择，用着色做寄存器分配，以及让它在 SSA 上变得容易的弦图。调度，以及编译器视为理所当然的预测器。用来检查这一切的模糊测试和求解器，还有一个去搜索规则漏掉之处的超级优化器。

9f5ec17d7e30.en: Where this comes back. Part 14 proves what the type checker's promises are worth, and Part 15 builds the runtimes where just-in-time compilers and garbage collectors live. Parts 16 and 17 replace the Job's algorithm, and the compiler carries the gain to the machine. Graph colouring and dynamic programming return in Parts 18 and 19, and Rice's theorem and NP-hardness are proved in Parts 25 and 26. Part 41 builds the system that runs the compiler, CompCert's proof is Part 54, Ken Thompson's self-reproducing compiler is the finale, and Part 60 compiles for accelerators.
9f5ec17d7e30.zh: 这些会在哪里再出现。第14部分证明类型检查器的承诺值多少，第15部分搭建即时编译器和垃圾回收器所在的运行时。第16和第17部分替换任务的算法，而编译器把收益带到机器上。图着色和动态规划在第18和第19部分回归，莱斯定理和 NP 难在第25和第26部分得到证明。第41部分搭建运行编译器的那个系统，CompCert 的证明是第54部分，肯·汤普森的自我复制编译器是终章，第60部分为加速器做编译。

0df4f4c0a286.en: In practice. Ship at level two, debug at level zero, and use level three only where a measurement says it helps. Read what the compiler produced: Compiler Explorer shows the assembly for any line of source, and gcc and clang will report which optimizations fired and which were missed. Help the optimizer with restrict, const and static, and with profile-guided and link-time optimization. Browsers and the Java and dot NET runtimes compile in tiers, interpreting first and compiling what turns out to be hot. And compiler engineering is a career of its own, now especially for GPUs and machine learning, in projects like XLA, MLIR and Triton.
0df4f4c0a286.zh: 在实践中。发布用第二级，调试用第零级，只在测量表明有帮助的地方用第三级。看看编译器产生了什么：Compiler Explorer 能显示任何一行源代码对应的汇编，gcc 和 clang 会报告哪些优化生效了、哪些错过了。用 restrict、const 和 static 帮助优化器，再加上剖析引导优化和链接时优化。浏览器以及 Java 和 .NET 的运行时分层编译，先解释执行，再编译那些被证明很热的代码。编译器工程本身就是一种职业，如今尤其集中在 GPU 和机器学习上，比如 XLA、MLIR 和 Triton 这些项目。

a12513f468bd.en: Six problems, with full solutions in the part's notes. Pause on any of them. The fifth is a build problem: our value numbering never merges two loads of the same address, which the demo function showed. Teach it to, safely, measure it, and let the fuzzer judge. The last, marked with a star, is a research problem: its answer is not known, and the notes say where to start.
a12513f468bd.zh: 六道习题，完整解答在这一部分的笔记里。可以在任何一道上暂停。第五道是动手题：我们的值编号从不合并对同一地址的两次读取，演示函数里就能看到。教会它安全地这样做，测量它，再让模糊测试来评判。最后一道标着星号，是研究问题：它的答案还没有人知道，笔记里说明了从哪里入手。

64f83021d983.en: Next time. A whole programming language made of nothing but functions, Church's lambda calculus. Types that tame it, a proof that well-typed programs cannot go wrong, and types inferred without being written. Part 14, Lambda and Types.
64f83021d983.zh: 下一次。一种完全由函数构成的编程语言，丘奇的 λ 演算。驯服它的类型，一个证明良类型程序不会出错的证明，以及不写出来也能推断的类型。第14部分，λ 与类型。

9bd24692775d.en: The books and papers this part follows are on screen and in the notes. Thank you for watching.
9bd24692775d.zh: 这一部分依据的书和论文都在屏幕上，也在笔记里。感谢观看。
